verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships as an official TypeScript SDK (`npm install better-auth`). It has a server instance with `auth.api` methods and a typed `authClient` (e.g. `signUp.email`), and the vendor claims 20+ framework integrations. Community users confirm the client and plugins work in production. Missing for 10: official non-JavaScript SDKs (a user reports the client library is JS-only with no iOS option), and documentation on building custom clients for other languages.
